findings.detail: Block 000006: hockey 'trip' is an illegal tripping action; 'будто Илья споткнулся' incorrectly makes Ilya stumble. Translate as suspected подножка.
Block 000221: 'I’m out for the playoffs' means Ilya cannot play while injured, not that the team has been eliminated; 'Я вылетел из плей-офф' shifts the meaning.
Block 000179: 'not as bulky' does not mention particular shoulders/muscles; avoid invented anatomical detail.
Block 000238: remove translator-added italics around song title; original has no italics.
Block 000047: correct awkward Russian calque 'с лишь чуть более ненормальной скоростью' while preserving rushed restrained walking.
